job:
PRODUCT DESIGNER
TechFlow – London

We're building consumer mobile applications used by over 500,000 people. Our design team drives product strategy and user experience. We're looking for a Product Designer to lead design for our fitness and wellness suite.

About the Role:

You'll work cross-functionally with engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, test, and ship features. This is a high-impact position where design directly influences product direction and user outcomes.

MUST-HAVES:

- 3+ years of professional product design experience at a technology company or design studio
- Advanced proficiency in Figma for wireframing, prototyping, and design systems
- Demonstrated experience planning and conducting usability testing with real users
- Proven track record shipping products with engineering teams from design handoff through launch
- Portfolio with case studies showing end-to-end product design work

NICE-TO-HAVES:

- Experience designing mobile health, fitness, or wellness applications
- Familiarity with design systems at scale
- Knowledge of analytics and data-driven design decisions
- Experience mentoring junior designers
- Background in user research methodology

We offer competitive salary, flexible working, and professional development budget.
